review:
Dragon's Gold 100 is a 100-payline slot with Asian themes: lanterns, golden coins and imperial palaces, with the Eastern dragon as the wild. The dragon wild can expand to fill its reel, completing wins across many of the 100 lines.

The Maneki-Neko cat and another symbol act as scatters, and an optional card gamble is available after base-game wins. BGaming rates the game high volatility with a 3,000x maximum, and the RTP is 96.07%. There's no traditional free spins round described, so wins come mainly from line hits and expanding wilds. A good choice if you like busy line slots with a classic Asian look.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
